document.cue: Describe an online event or class that you attended.

text: A while ago, I attended a two-day online workshop on digital marketing, which was run by a company based in London. I came across it on social media, and since it was free for students, I signed up straight away, even though I knew very little about the subject.

To join, I simply had to click on a link in my email at the scheduled time. There were around two hundred participants from all over the world, which made it quite lively. The speaker started with a presentation about how brands attract customers, and then we were divided into small virtual rooms to work on a mini project. In my group, there was a girl from Spain and a guy from Brazil, and it was fascinating to hear how marketing differs from one country to another. Afterwards, the organisers sent everyone a certificate and a list of useful links, which was a nice touch.

On the whole, I'd say it was a positive experience. It was convenient because I could join from my bedroom without spending money on travel, and the recordings were available afterwards, so I could review the parts I'd missed. The downside was that my connection froze a couple of times, and it was harder to build proper relationships than it would have been in person. Nevertheless, I picked up some practical skills, and it actually inspired me to take a longer course on the same topic.

tips.en: Every bullet is covered in order, so the talk sounds complete.
tips.kk: Жоспардың әр тармағы ретімен ашылған, сондықтан әңгіме тұтас естіледі.
tips.ru: Каждый пункт плана раскрыт по порядку, поэтому рассказ звучит целостно.
tips.example: A while ago, I attended a two-day online workshop on digital marketing

tips.en: Details about the group make the story believable.
tips.kk: Топ құрамы туралы мәліметтер әңгімені сенімді етеді.
tips.ru: Подробности о составе группы делают рассказ достоверным.
tips.example: To join, I simply had to click on a link in my email at the scheduled time

tips.en: A balanced evaluation with pros and cons answers 'whether it was good'.
tips.kk: Артықшылығы мен кемшілігі бар салмақты баға «whether it was good» тармағына жауап береді.
tips.ru: Взвешенная оценка с плюсами и минусами отвечает на «whether it was good».
tips.example: On the whole, I'd say it was a positive experience

note.en: Introduction: what the event was and how you found out about it.
note.kk: Кіріспе: бұл қандай іс-шара және ол туралы қалай білдіңіз.
note.ru: Вступление: что за мероприятие и как вы о нём узнали.

note.en: Body: how you joined and what happened.
note.kk: Негізгі бөлім: қалай қосылдыңыз және не болды.
note.ru: Основная часть: как вы подключились и что происходило.

note.en: Conclusion: an evaluation of the experience with pros and cons.
note.kk: Қорытынды: артықшылықтары мен кемшіліктері бар тәжірибе бағасы.
note.ru: Заключение: оценка опыта с плюсами и минусами.
